name: application-big-number-delta-tile
title: Big Number Delta Tile
description: Oversized KPI tile pairing a large number with a period-over-period percentage change, trend arrow, and plain-language comparison label — a comparison-focused alternative to the more general stat-tile.
useWhen: The headline metric itself deserves the most visual weight on the page (revenue, active users, etc.).
You want the period-over-period comparison spelled out in words ("vs last month") rather than a bare badge.
Trend direction and magnitude should be derived automatically from the delta value, not hand-picked.
avoidWhen: You're placing many metrics in a dense grid — the smaller application-stat-tile fits more tiles per row.
No comparison period exists for the metric — a plain number without delta is simpler.
You need an icon slot or sparkline alongside the number — extend stat-tile or use metric-sparkline-card instead.
responsiveBehavior: The tile is a single block sized to its content; place it in your own grid or flex row to control column count at each breakpoint.
accessibility: Trend direction is conveyed by both an arrow icon and a visually hidden text label (Increased/Decreased by), not color or rotation alone.
The comparison label (e.g. "vs last month") is always visible text, giving context the arrow alone can't.
Direction and color are derived from the sign of deltaPct, so they can never drift out of sync with the displayed percentage.

variants.title: Big number delta tile
variants.description: MRR tile with a large dollar figure, a +12.4% green uptrend, and a "vs last month" comparison label, on a light surface.
accessibility: Sign of the delta value alone determines both the arrow direction and green/red coloring.

variants.title: Big number delta tile (Dark)
variants.description: The same MRR tile, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Number, delta, and comparison text colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
